4//! Drawing blurred, rounded rectangles.
5//!
6//! Implementation is adapted from: <https://git.sr.ht/~raph/blurrr/tree/master/src/distfield.rs>.
7
8use crate::third_party::vello_common::encode::EncodedBlurredRoundedRectangle;
9use crate::third_party::vello_common::fearless_simd::{Simd, SimdBase, SimdFloat, f32x8, u8x16};
10use crate::third_party::vello_cpu::fine::{NumericVec, PosExt, ShaderResultF32};
11use crate::third_party::vello_cpu::kurbo::{Point, Vec2};

16#[derive(Debug)]
17pub(crate) struct BlurredRoundedRectFiller<S: Simd> {
18    r: f32x8<S>,
19    g: f32x8<S>,
20    b: f32x8<S>,
21    a: f32x8<S>,
22    alpha_calculator: AlphaCalculator<S>,
23}
24
25impl<S: Simd> BlurredRoundedRectFiller<S> {
26    pub(crate) fn new(simd: S, rect: &EncodedBlurredRoundedRectangle, start_x: f64, start_y: f64) -> Self {
27        let start_pos = rect.transform * Point::new(start_x, start_y);
28        let color_components = rect.color.as_premul_f32().components;
29        let r = f32x8::splat(simd, color_components[0]);
30        let g = f32x8::splat(simd, color_components[1]);
31        let b = f32x8::splat(simd, color_components[2]);
32        let a = f32x8::splat(simd, color_components[3]);
33        let simd_rect = SimdRoundedBlurredRect::new(rect, simd);
34        let alpha_calculator = AlphaCalculator::new(start_pos, rect.x_advance, rect.y_advance, simd_rect, simd);
35
36        Self { alpha_calculator, r, g, b, a }
37    }
38}
39
40impl<S: Simd> Iterator for BlurredRoundedRectFiller<S> {
41    type Item = ShaderResultF32<S>;
42
43    fn next(&mut self) -> Option<Self::Item> {
44        let next = self.alpha_calculator.next().unwrap();
45        let r = self.r * next;
46        let g = self.g * next;
47        let b = self.b * next;
48        let a = self.a * next;
49
50        Some(ShaderResultF32 { r, g, b, a })
51    }
52}
53
54impl<S: Simd> crate::third_party::vello_cpu::fine::Painter for BlurredRoundedRectFiller<S> {
55    fn paint_u8(&mut self, buf: &mut [u8]) {
56        for chunk in buf.chunks_exact_mut(64) {
57            let first = self.next().unwrap();
58            let simd = first.r.simd;
59            let second = self.next().unwrap();
60
61            let r = u8x16::from_f32(simd, simd.combine_f32x8(first.r, second.r));
62            let g = u8x16::from_f32(simd, simd.combine_f32x8(first.g, second.g));
63            let b = u8x16::from_f32(simd, simd.combine_f32x8(first.b, second.b));
64            let a = u8x16::from_f32(simd, simd.combine_f32x8(first.a, second.a));
65
66            let combined = simd.combine_u8x32(simd.combine_u8x16(r, g), simd.combine_u8x16(b, a));
67
68            simd.store_interleaved_128_u8x64(combined, (&mut chunk[..]).try_into().unwrap());
69        }
70    }
71
72    fn paint_f32(&mut self, buf: &mut [f32]) {
73        for chunk in buf.chunks_exact_mut(32) {
74            let (c1, c2) = self.next().unwrap().get();
75            c1.simd.store_interleaved_128_f32x16(c1, (&mut chunk[..16]).try_into().unwrap());
76            c2.simd.store_interleaved_128_f32x16(c2, (&mut chunk[16..]).try_into().unwrap());
77        }
78    }
79}

81#[derive(Debug)]
82struct AlphaCalculator<S: Simd> {
83    cur_pos: Point,
84    x_advance: Vec2,
85    y_advance: Vec2,
86    r: SimdRoundedBlurredRect<S>,
87    simd: S,
88}
89
90impl<S: Simd> AlphaCalculator<S> {
91    fn new(start_pos: Point, x_advance: Vec2, y_advance: Vec2, r: SimdRoundedBlurredRect<S>, simd: S) -> Self {
92        Self { cur_pos: start_pos, x_advance, y_advance, r, simd }
93    }
94}
95
96impl<S: Simd> Iterator for AlphaCalculator<S> {
97    type Item = f32x8<S>;
98
99    fn next(&mut self) -> Option<Self::Item> {
100        let i = f32x8::splat_pos(self.simd, self.cur_pos.x as f32, self.x_advance.x as f32, self.y_advance.x as f32);
101        let j = f32x8::splat_pos(self.simd, self.cur_pos.y as f32, self.x_advance.y as f32, self.y_advance.y as f32);
102        let r = &self.r;
103
104        let y = j - r.v1 * r.height;
105        // Equivalent to r.r1 + y.abs() - (r.h * r.v1)
106        let y0 = r.r1 - r.h.mul_sub(r.v1, y.abs());
107        let y1 = y0.max(r.v0);
108
109        let x = i - r.v1 * r.width;
110        // Equivalent to r.r1 + x.abs() - (r.w * r.v1)
111        let x0 = r.r1 - r.w.mul_sub(r.v1, x.abs());
112        let x1 = x0.max(r.v0);
113        let d_pos = (x1.powf(r.exponent) + y1.powf(r.exponent)).powf(r.recip_exponent);
114        let d_neg = x0.max(y0).min(r.v0);
115        let d = d_pos + d_neg - r.r1;
116        let z = r.scale * (f32x8::compute_erf7(self.simd, r.std_dev_inv * (r.min_edge + d)) - f32x8::compute_erf7(self.simd, r.std_dev_inv * d));
117
118        self.cur_pos += 2.0 * self.x_advance;
119
120        Some(z)
121    }
122}

124#[derive(Debug)]
125struct SimdRoundedBlurredRect<S: Simd> {
126    pub exponent: f32,
127    pub recip_exponent: f32,
128    pub scale: f32x8<S>,
129    pub std_dev_inv: f32x8<S>,
130    pub min_edge: f32x8<S>,
131    pub w: f32x8<S>,
132    pub h: f32x8<S>,
133    pub width: f32x8<S>,
134    pub height: f32x8<S>,
135    pub r1: f32x8<S>,
136    pub v0: f32x8<S>,
137    pub v1: f32x8<S>,
138}
139
140impl<S: Simd> SimdRoundedBlurredRect<S> {
141    fn new(encoded: &EncodedBlurredRoundedRectangle, s: S) -> Self {
142        let h = f32x8::splat(s, encoded.h);
143        let w = f32x8::splat(s, encoded.w);
144        let width = f32x8::splat(s, encoded.width);
145        let height = f32x8::splat(s, encoded.height);
146        let r1 = f32x8::splat(s, encoded.r1);
147        let exponent = encoded.exponent;
148        let recip_exponent = encoded.recip_exponent;
149        let scale = f32x8::splat(s, encoded.scale);
150        let min_edge = f32x8::splat(s, encoded.min_edge);
151        let std_dev_inv = f32x8::splat(s, encoded.std_dev_inv);
152        let v0 = f32x8::splat(s, 0.0);
153        let v1 = f32x8::splat(s, 0.5);
154
155        Self { exponent, recip_exponent, scale, std_dev_inv, min_edge, w, v0, v1, h, width, height, r1 }
156    }
157}

159trait FloatExt<S: Simd> {
160    // See https://raphlinus.github.io/audio/2018/09/05/sigmoid.html for a little
161    // explanation of this approximation to the erf function.
162    // Doing `inline(always)` seems to reduce performance for some reason.
163    /// Approximate the erf function.
164    fn compute_erf7(simd: S, x: Self) -> Self;
165    fn powf(self, x: f32) -> Self;
166}
167
168impl<S: Simd> FloatExt<S> for f32x8<S> {
169    fn compute_erf7(simd: S, x: Self) -> Self {
170        // Clamp `x`, because for large `x` the terms here become `inf`, causing the result to be 0 or
171        // `NaN`. This clamping doesn't lose any information, because `erf(±10) ≈ 1` well within `f64`
172        // machine precision, let alone `f32`.
173        let x = x.max(Self::splat(simd, -10.0)).min(Self::splat(simd, 10.0));
174        let x = x * Self::splat(simd, core::f32::consts::FRAC_2_SQRT_PI);
175        let xx = x * x;
176        let p1 = Self::splat(simd, 0.0104).mul_add(xx, Self::splat(simd, 0.03395));
177        let p2 = p1.mul_add(xx, Self::splat(simd, 0.24295));
178        let p3 = x * xx;
179        let x = p2.mul_add(p3, x);
180        let denom = x.mul_add(x, Self::splat(simd, 1.0)).sqrt();
181        x / denom
182    }
183
184    #[inline]
185    fn powf(mut self, x: f32) -> Self {
186        // TODO: SIMD
187        self[0] = self[0].powf(x);
188        self[1] = self[1].powf(x);
189        self[2] = self[2].powf(x);
190        self[3] = self[3].powf(x);
191        self[4] = self[4].powf(x);
192        self[5] = self[5].powf(x);
193        self[6] = self[6].powf(x);
194        self[7] = self[7].powf(x);
195
196        self
197    }
198}
